name: Ostrukh-on-Water Geothermal Polynya (Gemini 5.1 showcase station 14): the loess bluff of the village's terraces stepping down to Lake Ostrukh's frozen south-west bay, a 900 m polynya kept open by sub-lacustrine fault springs, frost smoke at a winter dawn, qanat mouths, the waterfront's edge

site.title: Ostrukh-on-Water Polynya

lake.note: the model's lake: 56 water cells (224 km2) at 1,849.8 m, its floor 1,835 m; its nearest cell 14 km north-east of the pin, the plain falling 140 m to it. The page brings its south-west shore to 1.2 km of the pin (an ideal type): PLAN.md section 8.3
